# Spec-Driven Development
1. Write a short spec: problem, users, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, open questions.
2. Turn each acceptance criterion into a test (or a manual check if untestable).
3. Get the spec reviewed before implementation.
4. Implement against the tests; update the spec when decisions change.
